ratings.reviewer_notes: Focused review specifically summarizing evidence and mechanisms for hypoxia-induced EMT mediated by HIF-1alpha.
Shows that hypoxia induces HIF-1alpha binding to the VASP promoter and that the resulting VASP signaling promotes EMT in hepatocellular carcinoma.
Mechanistically links a hypoxic microenvironment to stabilized HIF-1alpha and activation of EMT target genes through a RORgamma-HIF-1alpha complex.
Connects activation of HIF1 signaling to EMT through CAF-derived SFRP1 and FGFR2, but does not test hypoxia as the initiating stimulus.
Review directly discusses hypoxia-induced EMT and describes TET1 as a coactivator of HIF-1alpha-dependent transcription promoting EMT.
Demonstrates HIF-1alpha-dependent EMT through beta-catenin/Notch1, but the inducing exposure is isoflurane rather than hypoxia.
General review of integrins in cancer with no supplied evidence concerning hypoxia-induced EMT through HIF-1alpha.
HIF-1alpha knockdown suppresses EMT and metastasis in breast cancer, supporting an HIF-1alpha-to-EMT link, but hypoxia is not experimentally evaluated.
Review notes that sympathetic signaling can stabilize HIF-1alpha and promote EMT in HCC, but it does not directly address hypoxia-induced EMT.
Shows that hypoxia upregulates HIF-1alpha and that HIF-1alpha cooperates with TNF-alpha to stabilize Snail, repress E-cadherin-associated programs, and promote mesenchymal markers and invasion.
Directly examines hypoxia-induced EMT using HIF-1alpha shRNA and reports that suppression of HIF-1alpha signaling inhibits EMT in colorectal cancer models.
Shows HIF1A cooperation with CARM1 in EMT and invasion, but the abstract does not establish hypoxia as the inducing condition.
Provides direct mechanistic evidence that HIF-1alpha binds and activates the ZEB1 promoter and that ZEB1 inhibition abrogates HIF-1alpha-induced EMT; includes a hypoxia-mimetic context.
HIF-1alpha inhibition reverses stromal-conditioned-medium-induced EMT in benign prostatic cells, but hypoxia itself is not tested.
Directly shows that hypoxia increases HIF-1alpha and EMT in gastric cancer stem cells and that HIF-1alpha activates Snail; Snail knockdown reduces HIF-1alpha-induced EMT.
Direct experimental evidence that hypoxia induces EMT and that HIF-1alpha transcriptionally activates Snail by binding its hypoxia-response element; HIF-1alpha shRNA was used.

Examines EMT under hypoxia and reports that CoQ0 suppresses hypoxia-induced HIF-1alpha alongside mesenchymal markers and invasion, with HIF-1alpha silencing used mechanistically; the reported reversal result is somewhat difficult to interpret.
Shows hypoxia-induced Twist, EMT-marker changes, and invasion, with clinical correlation between Twist and HIF-1alpha, but does not directly perturb HIF-1alpha to establish mediation.
Clinical association study of HIF-1alpha, TWIST1, and Snail expression and prognosis; it provides correlative context but does not test hypoxia-to-HIF-1alpha-to-EMT causality.

Computational network model proposes sequential HIF-1alpha feedback loops involving SNAIL, TWIST, and miR-210 as the mechanism for EMT under hypoxia, but provides model-based rather than direct experimental evidence.
Shows HIF1alpha-dependent p63 activation and hybrid EMT in a redox-signaling breast cancer model, but does not test hypoxia as the initiating stimulus.
